title: Marriage, Divorce, and the Rich Young Man

questions.question: When the Pharisees asked is it lawful to divorce a wife for any cause, Jesus referred back to the Creator who made them what?
options: Male and female
Husband and wife
Like angels in heaven
Flesh and bone
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:4 (ESV): "He answered, 'Have you not read that he who created them from the beginning made them male and female...'"

questions.question: What therefore God has joined together, let not man ______.
options: Separate
Judge
Betray
Destroy
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:6 (ESV): "So they are no longer two but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, let not man separate."

questions.question: The Pharisees asked why Moses commanded a certificate of divorce. What was Jesus' explanation for Moses giving this command?
options: "Because of your hardness of heart Moses allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it was not so."
"Because you did not understand the law."
"Because some women bring shame upon a man's house."
"Because God revealed a new law in the desert."
questions.correctAnswer: "Because of your hardness of heart Moses allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it was not so."
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:8 (ESV): "He said to them, 'Because of your hardness of heart Moses allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it was not so.'"

questions.question: Except for what reason does Jesus say whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery?
options: Sexual immorality
Abandonment
Cruelty
Refusing to have children
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:9 (ESV): "And I say to you: whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery."

questions.question: When people brought children to Jesus so He could lay His hands on them, and the disciples rebuked the people, what did Jesus say?
options: "Let the little children come to me and do not hinder them, for to such belongs the kingdom of heaven."
"Unless they are circumcised they may not approach me."
"Wait until they are of the age of understanding."
"Send them to the synagogue to learn from the scribes first."
questions.correctAnswer: "Let the little children come to me and do not hinder them, for to such belongs the kingdom of heaven."
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:14 (ESV): "but Jesus said, 'Let the little children come to me and do not hinder them, for to such belongs the kingdom of heaven.'"

questions.question: A man came to Jesus asking, "Teacher, what good deed must I do to have eternal life?" What was Jesus' first command to him?
options: "If you would enter life, keep the commandments."
"Sell all that you have, and distribute to the poor."
"Repent and be baptized."
"Believe that I am the Son of God."
questions.correctAnswer: "If you would enter life, keep the commandments."
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:17 (ESV): "...If you would enter life, keep the commandments."

questions.question: The young man said he had kept all the commandments. So Jesus told him, "If you would be perfect, go...", do what?
options: "...sell what you possess and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me."
"...give half your wealth to the temple in Jerusalem."
"...fast for forty days in the wilderness."
"...abandon your family and walk the earth spreading my word."
questions.correctAnswer: "...sell what you possess and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me."
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:21 (ESV): "Jesus said to him, 'If you would be perfect, go, sell what you possess and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.'"

questions.question: Why did the young man go away sorrowful after hearing Jesus' instruction?
options: For he had great possessions
For he loved his family too much
For he was afraid of starvation
For he was heavily in debt
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:22 (ESV): "When the young man heard this he went away sorrowful, for he had great possessions."

questions.question: Jesus told His disciples it is easier for a camel to go through what than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God?
options: The eye of a needle
A narrow gate
The walls of Jerusalem
A fiery furnace
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:24 (ESV): "Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God."

questions.question: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, "Who then can be saved?" What did Jesus say?
options: "With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."
"Only the poorest of the poor in spirit."
"Those who give all they own to the synagogue."
"Few there are that will be saved."
questions.correctAnswer: "With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:26 (ESV): "But Jesus looked at them and said, 'With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.'"

questions.question: Peter pointed out they had left everything to follow Jesus. Jesus said in the new world, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, where will the twelve disciples sit?
options: They will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel
They will be angels in the sky
They will walk the streets of gold
They will serve the new kings of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: They will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:28 (ESV): "...you who have followed me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel."

questions.question: Everyone who has left houses or family or lands for Jesus' name's sake will receive what?
options: A hundredfold and will inherit eternal life
Great wealth on earth
A position of power in the new kingdom
Protection from disease and death
questions.correctAnswer: A hundredfold and will inherit eternal life
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:29 (ESV): "And everyone who has left houses or brothers... for my name's sake, will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life."

questions.question: How did Jesus conclude the teaching on the rich young man and the rewards of following Him?
options: "But many who are first will be last, and the last first."
"And the greatest of these is love."
"For the kingdom of heaven is at hand."
"Seek first the kingdom of God."
questions.correctAnswer: "But many who are first will be last, and the last first."
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:30 (ESV): "But many who are first will be last, and the last first."

questions.question: In the passage concerning eunuchs, Jesus says some were made eunuchs by men, some were born that way, and some made themselves eunuchs for what reason?
options: For the sake of the kingdom of heaven
To serve in foreign courts
Because of a vow to John the Baptist
To avoid paying Roman taxes
questions.correctAnswer: For the sake of the kingdom of heaven
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:12 (ESV): "...and there are eunuchs who have made themselves eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. Let the one who is able to receive this receive it."

questions.question: What was the specific reaction of Jesus when his disciples rebuked the children being brought to him?
options: He said, "Let the little children come to me..."
He wept realizing they did not understand his heart
He left the crowd entirely to pray
He sent the children back to their mothers immediately
questions.correctAnswer: He said, "Let the little children come to me..."
questions.explanation: Matthew 19:14 (ESV): "but Jesus said, 'Let the little children come to me and do not hinder them, for to such belongs the kingdom of heaven.'"

key_verse_text: But Jesus looked at them and said, "With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."
